doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Dating Uptown Blues to December 1939
summary: Brown reads that it was recorded December 14, 1939; Young works out he joined about three months earlier.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: So you joined the band in ‘39, you do your first recording that got you, that made you a star, let‘s say that.
I don‘t know when, does it say when it was recorded?
Well, that was the year I went in the band.
It says here that, ―Uptown Blues was recorded on December 14…December 14, 1939.
Ain‘t that something, that was right after I joined the band. It said December because I joined the band like…December 1939, wow. It must have been, read that again.
It said, ―Uptown Blues was recorded on December 14th, 1939.‖
December, 1939…December, 1939. If I joined the band in ‘39…that‘s, I joined the band in ‘39. So, September, October…what month?
December, yeah, after I was in the band about three months then, because it was like October, November, December…around that time is when I joined that band.
And, so, yeah, I‘d see, I‘m thinking about ‘40, so that was in…
December, yeah. So it was December ‘39? So, in a couple weeks it would have
Yeah, that‘s the way it was, yep, that‘s when I joined that band that year…yeah, ‘39.
